examples.title: Animated page window
examples.description: Opt in with pageWindow={5}. Numbers shift horizontally as you move through the list; First and Last show both boundaries. The selected mark follows the active page. Reduced motion removes travel.

examples.title: Existing ellipsis pagination
examples.description: Leave pageWindow unset to keep the v1 page range, first/last links, siblingCount and onPageChange behavior. Change only the import path when migrating.

examples.title: Page a list with a summary
examples.description: The list changes with currentPage. totalItems and pageSize provide the polite range announcement, including the final partial page.

examples.title: Native links and disabled controls
examples.description: Compose the existing primitives for URL navigation. Active links use aria-current=page; disabled controls keep their anchor semantics, block activation and leave the tab order.

examples.title: Compact window
examples.description: Use three slots in a narrow container. Longer windows scroll locally when necessary. Number slots stay stable, and Previous/Next labels hide below the small breakpoint.

examples.title: Right to left
examples.description: Inherit dir=rtl from the app. Arrow icons mirror, page progression stays logical, and the animated belt follows the reading direction.
